renderer_shared_indirect_sampling_help: Shared sampling budget for ray-traced reflections and global illumination.
renderer_ray_shadow_softness_help: Shadow softness follows the light's angular radius or source radius in its Inspector.
world_demo_Video_Gallery_PathTraced_desc: Two emissive video walls, spatial audio and optical materials. Walk through the original gallery with an orbit-camera character.
inspector_area_light_material_emission_h: Raster rectangles use the selected entity’s material emission texture, falling back to its base-colour texture. Video components supply the current frame. Light colour/intensity tint the result; disabling this keeps a constant source colour.
inspector_video_choose_to_preview: Choose a video to enable playback.
inspector_video_playback_help: Preview this video and its audio without starting the scene. Drag the timeline to seek; Stop returns to the first frame.
renderer_ssr_help: Off-screen and hidden surfaces retain environment reflections. Sampling bias trades GGX tail coverage for less noise; temporal filtering resets on camera cuts.
renderer_ssr_replaced: Path tracing or hardware ray-traced reflections take precedence over SSR.
texture_render_camera_help: Select a scene camera or drag a camera entity here.
texture_render_configuration_pending: These options are not applied to rendering yet.
inspector_vignette_center_help: Normalized viewport coordinates: (0, 0) is the top-left and (1, 1) is the bottom-right.
inspector_vignette_size_help: Size in centered screen coordinates: the viewport runs from -1 to 1 before aspect correction. Increase it to keep more of the image clear.
inspector_vignette_aspect_help: Scale horizontal distance by the render target's width / height, keeping a circle round.
water_custom_pending: Custom water meshes are not implemented yet.
water_simulation_pending: Settings are saved; wave simulation is not applied to the plane yet.
audio_drop_mixer: Drop an Audio Mixer entity here.
audio_drop_output: Drop an Audio Mixer or Audio Mixer Group entity here. Routing cycles are rejected.
audio_group_help: Sources routed here are mixed before this group's volume is applied.
audio_volume_help: Replaces distance attenuation. Multiplied by source volume.
audio_spread_help: 0: natural binaural width, 1: double stereo width.
audio_reverb_help: Wet send to an algorithmic reverb; this does not simulate room geometry.
audio_graph_help: Distance (world units). Drag points; double-click to add; right-click an interior point to remove.
renderer_cascaded_shadows_help: Use four directional shadow maps for more detail near the camera. Disable to use one map over the shadow distance, reducing shadow rendering work but also nearby detail.
inspector_group_description: Organizational folder. Members keep their own transform parents. Deleting the folder keeps its members.
hierarchy_move_rejected: Cannot move this item: the hierarchy would be cyclic or the target transform cannot be inverted.
viewport_tool_grab_soft_body: Grab soft body. Shows simulation vertices. Drag a vertex during Play or Simulate.
viewport_tool_move: Move: drag the arrows to reposition the selected object.
viewport_tool_rotate: Rotate: drag the rings to rotate the selected object.
viewport_tool_scale: Scale: drag the handles to resize the selected object.
viewport_tool_bounds: Bounds: show or hide object bounding boxes.
viewport_tool_world: World space: handles follow the scene axes. Click for local space.
viewport_tool_local: Local space: handles follow the object's axes. Click for world space.
viewport_tool_orthographic: Orthographic: objects keep the same apparent size at any distance. Click for perspective.
viewport_tool_perspective: Perspective: distant objects appear smaller. Click for orthographic.
viewport_tool_physics: Physics debug: show or hide collision shapes.
inspector_area_light_path_tracing: Raster: rectangle, sphere and tube. Path tracing: rectangle and mesh hierarchy. Rectangle faces local +Z; tube follows local X. Analytic raster lights do not cast shadow maps.
editor_layer_script_project_build_failed: Script project build failed. See Compiler Status for details.
preferences_script_project_open_failed: Could not open the script project. Check the selected editor installation.
inspector_light_position_help: When the fourth component is 1.0, lighting uses the light's position, which is the game object's position.
animation_graph_assign_a_valid_clip_to_e: Assign a valid clip to every state and resolve controller errors before playing.

editor_texture_compression_layer_no_supp: No supported images found in Resources/Textures or Resources/Cubemaps.
material_graph_editor_only_one_output_no: Only one output node is allowed.
material_graph_editor_yaml_generated: Graph YAML generated and written to the console. Shaders are not generated.
script_graph_graph_validated_ir_is_avail: Graph validated. IR is available below.
viewport_center_pivot_manipulate_around_: Center pivot: manipulate around the object's bounds. Click for pivot.
viewport_pivot_manipulate_around_the_ent: Pivot: manipulate around the entity origin. Click for center.
workspace_operation_the_operation_failed: The operation failed with an unknown error.

editor_layer_loading_the_project_scene_a: Loading the project scene and assets...
editor_layer_a_project_already_exists_th: A project already exists there. Choose Open Project or a new filename.
landscape_select_terrain_to_edit: Select a terrain entity in the Hierarchy to edit its landscape.
inspector_click_me_to_load_a_texture: Click me to load a texture.
inspector_choose_a_text_material_for_a_t: Choose a text material for a text component.
inspector_size_and_spacing_use_world_uni: Size and spacing use world units. The origin is the first line's baseline.
inspector_size_spacing_and_position_use_: Size, spacing and position use render pixels from the top-left. Screen placement is independent of the entity's world transform.
inspector_sensor_width_in_millimeters_se: Sensor width in millimeters. Sensor height follows the viewport aspect ratio.
inspector_lens_focal_length_in_millimete: Lens focal length in millimeters. When linked, longer focal lengths narrow the field of view.
inspector_minimum_f_stop_the_widest_open: Minimum f-stop: the widest opening supported by the lens. The diaphragm becomes rounder as the current aperture approaches this value.
inspector_lens_opening_expressed_as_an_f: Lens opening expressed as an f-stop. Lower values produce a shallower depth of field; higher values keep more of the scene sharp.
inspector_distance_from_the_camera_to_th: Distance from the camera to the sharp focus plane, in world units (meters).
inspector_limits_the_blur_radius_in_pixe: Limits the blur radius in pixels. Higher values allow softer backgrounds; zero removes the blur.
inspector_roundness_at_maximum_aperture_: Roundness at maximum aperture: zero is polygonal, one is circular. Stopping down makes the blades more visible.
inspector_rotates_the_diaphragm_and_the_: Rotates the diaphragm and the resulting bokeh.
lighting_could_not_load_the_environment_: Could not load the environment map.
editor_hello_cube_layer_press_y_to_hide_: Press Y to hide/show this window.
editor_hello_triangle_layer_press_h_to_h: Press H to hide/show this window.
editor_ray_trace_layer_hardware_triangle: Hardware triangle traversal | BLAS + TLAS | Ray generation / miss / closest hit
editor_texture_compression_layer_bc7_bc6: BC7 / BC6H CPU import benchmark | F9 toggles this window
editor_texture_compression_layer_uses_th: Uses the production encoder regardless of CompressTextures. Full-resolution, mip zero, one image at a time; large images encode block groups concurrently. No GPU upload/render timings.
editor_texture_compression_layer_debug_b: Debug build: use Release for representative compression timings.
editor_texture_compression_layer_times_a: Times are sample means, without a discarded warm-up. The first large encode includes worker startup. File reads/writes may use the OS cache; reload is measured immediately after writing and is not cold-disk throughput.

editor_texture_compression_layer_payload: Payload sizes exclude GPU allocation padding/mipmaps. RGBA32F retained = HDR compression fallback.
inspector_opaque_scene_silhouettes_zero_: Opaque scene silhouettes. Zero disables contours. Not used by material thumbnails or path tracing.
inspector_screen_space_sigma_rgb_profile: Screen-space sigma = RGB profile width x scatter scale x 2 pixels. Zero disables scattering.
inspector_relative_view_depth_change_bef: Relative view-depth change before rejecting blur samples. Zero disables depth rejection; object boundaries remain protected.
inspector_artist_authored_thickness_in_p: Artist-authored thickness in profile units. Larger values absorb more backlight. This approximation does not measure the mesh or shadow-map thickness.
inspector_0_full_scattering_influence_1_: 0: full scattering influence. 1: ordinary surface lighting. Does not change surface transparency.
inspector_diffuse_only_horizontal_and_ve: Diffuse-only horizontal and vertical blur. Specular, ambient and emission stay sharp. Widths are measured in render pixels.
inspector_raster_opaque_masked_surfaces_: Raster uses screen-space diffusion. Path tracing uses the PBRT BSSRDF controls above. The material preview uses raster shading.
inspector_c_support_is_disabled_in_this_: C# support is disabled in this build. Configure MIKOTO_ENABLE_DOTNET_SCRIPTING=ON with the .NET 10 SDK.
inspector_edit_your_cs_file_and_press_pl: Edit your .cs file and press Play. Keep the class name the same as the filename. Scripts in the same folder compile together; compiler errors appear in the console. Stop and Play again to apply changes.
inspector_could_not_open_the_editor_choo: Could not open the editor. Choose its executable in Preferences > External Tools. See the console for details.
inspector_the_imported_skin_selects_this: The imported skin selects this skeleton. Playback is shared by all rigs on the animator entity.
inspector_create_an_independent_material: Create an independent material for this entity. Otherwise edits affect every entity sharing it.
inspector_four_wheel_awd_y_up_z_forward_: Four-wheel AWD, +Y up, +Z forward. Requires a dynamic rigid body, non-trigger collider and unit world scale. Scale the body visual as a child.
inspector_vehicle_disabled_settings_must: Vehicle disabled: settings must be finite and positive; maximum suspension length must be at least the minimum.
inspector_parent_directly_to_the_vehicle: Parent directly to the vehicle chassis. Set visual scale/orientation before simulation, then capture the correction.
inspector_outside_stroke_proportional_to: Outside stroke proportional to font size. Zero disables it; colour emoji preserve their artwork.
inspector_characters_have_no_loaded_glyp: %zu characters have no loaded glyph. New glyphs load when rendered; choose another font if replacements remain.
inspector_enabled_listeners_can_hear_3d_: Enabled listeners can hear 3D sources. Sources use the closest listener unless explicitly pinned.
inspector_position_and_orientation_follo: Position and orientation follow the world transform, including parents. Turn this entity to change the listening direction.
inspector_steam_audio_hrtf_places_this_s: Steam Audio HRTF places this sound around the listener. Off preserves the clip's stereo image for music and UI.
inspector_position_and_velocity_follow_t: Position and velocity follow the entity's world transform. Listener orientation controls the perceived direction.
inspector_derive_field_of_view_from_foca: Derive field of view from focal length and filmback width. Leave off to preserve the framing of older scenes.
inspector_number_of_diaphragm_blades_few: Number of diaphragm blades. Fewer blades make polygonal bokeh more apparent when stopping down.
inspector_focus_distance_is_measured_in_: Focus distance is measured in meters. Aperture changes blur, not exposure. Quality and focus-layer visualization are in the Renderer panel. Orthographic cameras remain sharp.
inspector_convex_uses_the_mesh_hull_tria: Convex uses the mesh hull. Triangle meshes require a static body. Skinned meshes use the imported bind pose.
inspector_runs_in_simulate_or_play_parti: Runs in Simulate or Play. Particles stay in world space after emission. Scene saves include these settings.
lighting_environment_map_and_atmosphere_: Environment Map and Atmosphere provide ambient lighting and reflections. Scene lights remain active. The main camera controls the visible background.
lighting_no_complete_environment_map_cho: No complete environment map. Choose a panorama below or assign all six faces in a Skybox component. Camera clear flags alone do not supply a map.
lighting_physical_sky_atmospheric_haze_a: Physical sky, atmospheric haze, and sky reflections. Set the camera clear flags to Skybox to show the sky.
lighting_uses_the_active_directional_lig: Uses the active directional light with the lowest entity ID, including its world rotation, color and intensity. Without one, the angles below are used. Atmosphere does not create a direct light.
lighting_rayleigh_controls_molecular_sca: Rayleigh controls molecular scattering; Mie adds aerosol haze and the glow around the sun. Ozone absorbs light, especially around sunset.
lighting_for_small_scenes_reduce_the_ran: For small scenes, reduce the range for more depth precision. Sky scattering continues to the atmosphere boundary.
lighting_1000_units_per_kilometer_means_: 1000 units per kilometer means one world unit is one meter. The atmosphere uses +Y as up. Below-ground views are clamped above the planet surface.
material_editor_particle_material_graph_: Particle material graph authoring. Shader integration is pending; use Particle Simulation for the current emitter preview.
material_editor_text_material_sample_fon: Text material: sample font with color and opacity. The font is chosen by the text component.
material_editor_default_pbr_clear_coat_t: Standard Lit�Clear coat�Toon shading�Flat shading�Cell shading�Subsurface scattering�Dielectric�Conductor�Unlit��
material_editor_opaque_scene_silhouettes: Opaque scene silhouettes. Zero disables contours. Not used by material thumbnails or path tracing.
material_editor_screen_space_sigma_rgb_p: Screen-space sigma = RGB profile width x scatter scale x 2 pixels. Zero disables scattering.
material_editor_relative_view_depth_chan: Relative view-depth change before rejecting blur samples. Zero disables depth rejection; object boundaries remain protected.
material_editor_artist_authored_thicknes: Artist-authored thickness in profile units. Larger values absorb more backlight. This approximation does not measure the mesh or shadow-map thickness.
material_editor_0_full_scattering_influe: 0: full scattering influence. 1: ordinary surface lighting. Does not change surface transparency.
material_editor_diffuse_only_horizontal_: Diffuse-only horizontal and vertical blur. Specular, ambient and emission stay sharp. Widths are measured in render pixels.
material_editor_preview_uses_metallic_ro: Preview uses metallic / roughness PBR. Other saved shading settings are preserved.
material_editor_preview_lighting_is_inde: Preview lighting is independent of the scene. Background blur does not change material roughness.
material_editor_used_by_msdf_and_slug_te: Used by MSDF and Slug text. The component tint multiplies this material. Font and layout remain on the text component.
material_graph_editor_graph_edits_are_sa: Graph edits are saved with the material; rendering still uses its existing properties.
network_debug_layer_python_http_server_t: Python HTTP server tester | Ctrl+Shift+F8 toggles this window
network_debug_layer_use_localhost_127_0_: Use localhost, 127.0.0.1 or [::1]. The server's [::] address is a bind address.
network_debug_layer_request_limits: HTTP GET | 5 s timeout | 1 MiB response limit | No redirect following
network_debug_layer_start_your_server_th: Start your server, then press GET. A 404 response still confirms the connection works.
network_debug_layer_preview_limited_to_t: Preview limited to the first 64 KiB.
network_debug_layer_raw_text_preview_con: Raw text preview; control bytes are shown as dots.
particle_simulation_emission_spawn_updat: Emission -> Spawn -> Update -> Appearance -> Billboard. Compiles to the existing emitter recipe; arbitrary modules are not supported yet.
text_debug_layer_msdf_left_slug_right_co: MSDF (left) | Slug (right) | Colour emoji should match in both columns
text_debug_layer_font_coverage_differs_i: Font coverage differs: Inter may show replacements for Japanese. General complex-script shaping is not part of this emoji path.
viewport_scene_rendering_is_unavailable_: Scene rendering is unavailable with this graphics backend. You can still use the editor panels.
animation_graph_save_your_changes_before: Save your changes before opening another controller?
animation_graph_select_an_entity_with_an: Select an entity with an Animator component to bind clips and play. You can design and save this example without a model.
animation_graph_this_model_has_no_animat: This model has no animation clips. Pose its skeleton using Inverse kinematics in the Inspector.
animation_graph_drag_an_output_pin_to_an: Drag an output pin to another state's input to add a transition. Drag Entry to choose the default state.
animation_graph_this_character_s_graph_p: This character's graph plays and blends all skeletons together.
animation_graph_choose_a_clip_available_: Choose a clip available on this model before playing.
animation_graph_select_a_state_or_transi: Select a state or transition to edit it. Green marks Entry, orange marks the default state, and cyan marks the state playing on the model.
animation_graph_1_0_waits_for_one_loop_c: 1.0 waits for one loop. Conditions must also pass.
animation_graph_transitions_are_checked_: Transitions are checked in list order. The first matching outgoing transition wins. Changes take effect immediately without blending.
animator_inspector_crossfade_time_when_c: Crossfade time when changing clips. Controller edges have their own blend duration.
animator_inspector_this_model_has_a_skel: This model has a skeleton but no animation clips. Its rest pose is displayed; use inverse kinematics below to pose it.
animator_inspector_playback_controls_all: Playback controls all rigs; IK edits apply to the selected skeleton.
animator_inspector_ik_evaluates_after_an: IK evaluates after animation blending. Targets use skeleton model space; joint axes use local space.
animator_select_an_entity_to_create_or_e: Select an entity to create or edit keyframe animation.
animator_animate_local_position_rotation: Animate local position, rotation, scale and light properties. Keys are saved with the scene.
animator_select_a_row_and_frame_then_edi: Select a row and frame, then edit Value to create a key. Drag diamonds to retime. Wheel zooms; middle-drag pans. Stop restores the original pose.
animator_for_animated_physics_objects_us: For animated physics objects, use a kinematic body so simulation does not overwrite the keyed transform.
materials_browser_material_tracking_is_n: Material tracking is not implemented yet.
animations_browser_animation_tracking_is: Animation tracking is not implemented yet.

script_graph_entityscript_api_authoring_: EntityScript API authoring. Transforms target the owning entity (local space; rotation in degrees). Execution is not connected yet.
script_graph_members_exposed_by_mikoto_s: Members exposed by Mikoto's EntityScript API. Click to add a node.
script_graph_load_a_source_file_or_selec: Load a source file or select a loaded script to preview it beside the graph.
stats_backend_dependent_heap_accounting_: Backend-dependent heap accounting; this is not the process VRAM figure. On integrated GPUs, local memory also resides in system RAM.
stats_logical_cached_model_and_texture_p: Logical cached model and texture payloads, not process residency. Excludes scene arenas, render targets, driver heaps and some CPU structures. Referenced models cannot be evicted.
stats_estimated_admission_reservations_n: Estimated admission reservations, not measured staging or driver allocation. An oversized import may run alone.
stats_mib_1_048_576_bytes_local_gpu_memo: MiB = 1,048,576 bytes. Local GPU memory also uses system RAM on integrated GPUs.

lighting_six_face_cubemap_edit_faces_in_: Six-face cubemap (edit faces in the skybox inspector).

material_editor_drag_to_orbit_scroll_to_: Drag to orbit  |  Scroll to zoom
material_editor_each_domain_has_its_own_: Each domain has its own settings and graph. Only the active domain is saved.
material_editor_scene_raster_rendering_i: Raster uses screen-space diffusion. Path tracing uses the PBRT BSSRDF controls above. The material preview uses raster shading.
material_editor_assign_all_required_imag: Assign all required images to use this skybox in a scene.
particle_simulation_gpu_counts_are_not_r: GPU counts are not read back.
particle_simulation_camera_facing_discs_: Camera-facing discs | Colour and size over lifetime
particle_simulation_changes_restart_the_: Changes restart the preview. Apply explicitly to update a scene emitter.
particle_simulation_billboard_discs_the_: Billboard discs; the ground is a visual reference, not a particle collider.
particle_simulation_drag_to_orbit_scroll: Drag to orbit; scroll to zoom.
stats_capture_paused_values_and_history_: Capture paused. Values and history are frozen.
stats_waiting_for_a_valid_frame_sample: Waiting for a valid frame sample.
stats_pause_capture_to_zoom_and_pan_the_: Pause capture to zoom and pan the history.
stats_rolling_window_up_to_frames_fps_fr: Rolling window: up to %zu frames. FPS = frames / elapsed time.
stats_model_texture_payload_cpu_gpu_esti: Model / texture payload CPU / GPU estimates
viewport_wind_zones_hint: Cyan: active zone boundary. Dim cyan: full-strength region. Yellow arrows: sampled total wind, including overlapping zones. Directional wind is global; its arrow is drawn at the area origin.
viewport_controls_enabled_camera_frustum: Controls enabled camera frustums and point/spot light ranges.
inspector_uses_triangle_normals_normal_m: Uses triangle normals; normal maps are ignored.
inspector_0_wide_far_profile_1_tight_nea: 0: wide far profile. 1: tight near profile.
inspector_mesh_shared_memory: Sizes describe shared mesh payloads; instances may reuse them.
inspector_the_spot_position_is_determine: The spot position is determined by the objects position.
inspector_outer_cone_half_angle_in_degre: Outer cone half-angle in degrees. Full cone width is twice this value.
inspector_width_of_the_fade_inside_the_o: Width of the fade inside the outer cone, in degrees. Zero gives a hard edge.
inspector_source_preview_is_available_fo: Source preview is available for .cs files.
inspector_no_animator_is_assigned_to_thi: No animator is assigned to this entity.
inspector_add_a_dynamic_rigid_body_to_en: Add a dynamic rigid body to enable the vehicle.
inspector_material_color_and_opacity_mul: Material color and opacity multiply the component tint.
inspector_choose_a_wav_mp3_or_flac_clip_: Choose a WAV, MP3 or FLAC clip to enable playback.
inspector_1_0_is_the_original_level_high: 1.0 is the original level. High gains can clip the final mix.
inspector_upper_distance_used_by_attenua: Upper distance used by attenuation. This is not a universal silence cutoff.
inspector_pitch_shift_from_relative_moti: Pitch shift from relative motion. Zero disables Doppler.
inspector_hrtf_steam_audio_best_heard_on: HRTF: Steam Audio | Best heard on headphones
inspector_restore_the_default_lens_and_f: Restore the default lens and focus settings, and disable depth of field.
inspector_link_lens_to_field_of_view: Link lens to field of view
inspector_ctrl_click_to_enter_an_exact_v:

Ctrl-click to enter an exact value.
inspector_depth_of_field_requires_a_pers: Depth of field requires a perspective camera.
inspector_select_an_entity_in_the_hierar: Select an entity in the Hierarchy or Scene to edit its components.
inspector_gpu_simulation_live_dropped_co: GPU simulation: live/dropped counts are not read back.
inspector_widgets_belong_to_this_canvas_: Widgets belong to this canvas; they are not scene entities.
inspector_select_a_widget_to_edit_its_pr: Select a widget to edit its properties.
inspector_tab_to_focus_enter_space_to_ac: Tab to focus; Enter/Space to activate; arrows adjust sliders in Play.
material_editor_uses_triangle_normals_no: Uses triangle normals; normal maps are ignored.
material_editor_0_wide_far_profile_1_tig: 0: wide far profile. 1: tight near profile.
editor_layer_scene_rendering_is_not_avai: Scene rendering is not available with %s yet.
editor_layer_you_can_continue_browsing_a: You can continue browsing and editing the project. The scene viewport will remain empty. To render scenes, select Vulkan or D3D12 in app-config.toml and restart the editor.
editor_layer_static_gray_dynamic_yellow_: Static: gray | Dynamic: yellow | Sleeping: red
editor_layer_physics_debug_drawing_requi: Physics debug drawing requires a Debug build.
editor_layer_lights_per_cluster_at_the_v: Lights per cluster at the visible surface. Blue: 0, green: about 16, red: 256. Magenta stripes: overflow / full light-list fallback.
editor_layer_blend_the_cluster_heatmap_o: Blend the cluster heatmap over the final image. Uses opaque surface depth; sky remains unchanged.
editor_layer_save_project_settings_befor: Project settings have unsaved changes. Save them before closing?
editor_layer_save_your_current_scene_bef: Save your current scene before changing the workspace?
editor_layer_open_a_project_create_one_o: Open a project, create one, or enter Sandbox to test a scene without a project.
editor_layer_sandbox_description: Explore the Sandbox showcase without opening a project.
editor_layer_sandbox_notice: You are in Sandbox mode. Explore this prefab showcase, or press Play to see vehicles and physics. Sandbox has no project attached. Individual demos are available under File > Default Projects.
renderer_scene_rendering_is_unavailable_: Scene rendering is unavailable with the selected graphics backend. You can still browse and edit the project.
renderer_applies_to_all_scenes_switching: Applies to all scenes. Switching restarts emitters on their next simulation update. GPU mode keeps particle state and sorting on the GPU; no live-particle readback.
renderer_experimental_256_emitters_and_6: Experimental: 256 emitters and 65,536 reserved particle slots per view. Rebuilding render targets restarts GPU particles. Particles are rendered in raster mode only.
renderer_replaces_diffuse_environment_li: Replaces diffuse environment lighting on opaque meshes. Samples accumulate while stationary; camera or scene changes restart accumulation. Moving views may be noisy.
renderer_hybrid_effects_require_the_vulk: Hybrid effects require the Vulkan or D3D12 scene renderer.
renderer_hardware_ray_tracing_is_unavail: Hardware ray tracing is unavailable on this device/backend.
renderer_applied_to_the_selected_entity_: Applied to the selected entity and its highlighted hierarchy.
renderer_controls_shadow_map_detail_ray_: Controls shadow-map detail. Ray-traced shadows and path tracing use their own sampling settings.
renderer_msaa_covers_opaque_and_transpar: MSAA covers opaque and transparent meshes and selection outlines. Post effects, text, particles and other editor overlays use the resolved image.
renderer_controls_aperture_sampling_high: Controls aperture sampling. Higher settings improve bokeh at a greater GPU cost. Off disables DoF for every camera.
renderer_shows_the_camera_s_circle_of_co: Shows the camera's circle of confusion before blur. Brightness reaches full intensity at a four-pixel radius. Exposure and bloom do not affect these colors.
renderer_enable_dof_and_edit_the_lens_in: Enable DoF and edit the lens in the camera Inspector. Scene preview uses the main camera's lens settings from the editor viewpoint.
renderer_restore_the_original_three_pixe: Restore the original three-pixel diagonal RGB separation.
renderer_pixel_step_between_red_green_an: Pixel step between red, green and blue along the dominant axis. Blue shifts twice this distance. Three pixels restores the original strength; zero disables the effect.
renderer_45_degrees_original_diagonal_0_: 45 degrees: original diagonal. 0: horizontal. 90: vertical. Offsets are subtracted from the sample coordinates.
renderer_directional_rgb_separation_acro: Directional RGB separation across the whole image. Based on the original moonlightoctopus shader. View the Default output to see it.
renderer_open_a_scene_to_configure_tone_: Open a scene to configure tone mapping.
renderer_applies_exposure_and_clamps_hig: Applies exposure and clamps highlights. Useful for comparison.
renderer_smoothly_compresses_each_color_: Smoothly compresses each color channel as brightness increases.
renderer_filmic_curve_normalized_against: Filmic curve normalized against a reference white point.
renderer_preserves_color_through_the_mid: Preserves color through the midtones and compresses bright highlights.
renderer_exposure_and_gamma_follow_the_a: Exposure and gamma follow the active camera.
renderer_view_the_default_output_to_comp: View the Default output to compare operators. Saved with the scene.
renderer_disable_to_check_whether_camera: Disable to check whether camera frustum tests are hiding geometry in the Scene view. Shadow culling is unchanged.
renderer_scene_view_only_green_intersect: Scene view only. Green: intersecting draw bounds. Red: outside. Amber: conservatively retained (animated or invalid bounds). Instanced batches are tested together. This shows frustum culling, not occlusion.
renderer_set_an_active_camera_as_main_ca: Set an active camera as Main Camera in the Inspector to use this view.
renderer_scene_tint_red_green_blue_yello: Scene tint: red / green / blue / yellow from near to far. Colors blend across cascade transitions; lighting and shadows remain visible. Dark tint: outside coverage or no directional shadow map.
renderer_shadow_maps_require_cast_shadow: Shadow maps require Cast shadows on the light (up to 5 lights of each type). Point and spot shadows reach only as far as the light radius. These counters show CPU submissions, not GPU depth coverage.
renderer_bloom_uses_emissive_materials_w: Bloom uses emissive materials with Enable bloom checked. Intensity sets glow strength, scatter favors the broad halo, and radius widens the blur. Emission strength controls how bright the surface itself is.
runtime_console_command_help_tab_to_comp: Command (help, Tab to complete, Up/Down for history)

renderer_ao_help: Zero distance means unlimited. Ray-traced AO replaces SSAO for raster ambient lighting; path tracing uses it as a separate debug view.
renderer_soft_shadows_help: Contact-hardening raster shadows use the sun’s angular radius and point-light source radius.

gpu_stats_selected_view_s_graphics_submi: Selected view's graphics submission only. Results arrive after GPU completion; capture never waits for the GPU. Instrumentation can affect timings.
gpu_stats_enable_capture_and_render_a_sc: Enable capture and render a scene to collect a sample.
gpu_stats_disable_capture_to_zoom_and_pa: Disable capture to zoom and pan the history.
gpu_stats_no_frame_graph_gpu_capture_is_: No frame graph. GPU capture is unavailable.
gpu_stats_supported_means_exposed_by_the: Supported means exposed by the active RHI backend on the graphics queue. Occlusion and stream-output counters require explicit query scopes; this panel captures timing and pipeline statistics.
gpu_stats_elapsed_milliseconds_are_calcu: Elapsed milliseconds are calculated from timestamp pairs. This is separate from Vulkan's optional elapsed-timer query. Query counters do not measure overall GPU utilization, VRAM bandwidth, or temperature.
simulation_settings_the_current_broad_ph: The current broad phase uses two engine-defined layers. Body type, mass, friction and restitution are edited on each entity in the Inspector.
simulation_settings_gravity_applies_to_t: Gravity applies to the active scene. During Play, changes affect the runtime copy.
simulation_settings_open_a_scene_to_conf: Open a scene to configure simulation.
audio_mixer_applies_to_every_voice_this_: Applies to every voice. This session control is not saved with the scene.
audio_mixer_stereo_output_3d_sources_use: Stereo output | 3D sources use Steam Audio HRTF
audio_mixer_open_a_scene_to_mix_its_audi: Open a scene to mix its audio sources.
audio_mixer_use_headphone_hrtf_positioni: Use headphone HRTF positioning. Off preserves stereo for music and UI.
audio_mixer_source_gain_1_0_is_the_origi: Source gain; 1.0 is the original level. High gains can clip.
audio_mixer_add_an_audio_component_to_an: Add an Audio component to an entity to create a source.
audio_mixer_changes_during_play_affect_t: Changes during Play affect the runtime scene copy.
audio_profiler_open_a_scene_to_inspect_i: Open a scene to inspect its audio voices.
audio_profiler_active_scene_voice_monito: Active-scene voice monitor. Gain is a source setting, not a measured output level. Audio-thread CPU time is not measured here.

game_preview_game_scene_rendering_is_una: Game scene rendering is unavailable for the current backend.
game_preview_no_active_main_camera_add_a: No active main camera. Add a Camera component and mark it as Main Camera in the Inspector.
settings_fly_turns_at_the_camera_positio: Fly turns at the camera position. Orbit moves around a fixed look-at point. Switching preserves the current view.
settings_world_space_point_to_orbit_edit: World-space point to orbit. Editing it aims at the new point without moving the camera.
settings_choose_the_pivot_along_the_curr: Choose the pivot along the current view ray. Use W/S while navigating to dolly toward/away from it.
settings_aim_at_the_selected_entity_s_wo: Aim at the selected entity's world origin and orbit around it.
settings_world_units_per_second_hold_rig: World units per second. Hold right mouse in the Scene view to navigate.
settings_higher_values_turn_the_camera_f: Higher values turn the camera farther for the same mouse movement.
settings_approximate_response_time_for_m: Approximate response time for movement and rotation. Higher is softer; zero responds immediately.
settings_hold_right_mouse_to_orbit_a_d_a: Hold right mouse to orbit. A/D and Q/E (or Space) pan the pivot; W/S dolly toward or away from it.
settings_vertical_viewing_angle_wider_an: Vertical viewing angle. Wider angles show more of the scene.
settings_visible_height_in_world_units_s: Visible height in world units. Smaller values zoom in; width follows the viewport aspect ratio.
settings_closest_visible_distance_keepin: Closest visible distance. Keeping this reasonably large improves depth precision.
settings_farthest_visible_distance_must_: Farthest visible distance. Must be greater than the near clip.
settings_editor_camera_position_in_world: Editor camera position in world units (X, Y, Z).
settings_return_to_the_starting_viewpoin: Return to the starting viewpoint. Lens and navigation settings are preserved.
settings_synchronize_presentation_with_t: Synchronize presentation with the display refresh rate. Applies to the current editor session.
settings_camera_settings_will_be_saved_w: Camera settings will be saved with the project.
settings_camera_settings_for_this_sandbo: Camera settings for this Sandbox session.
compiler_status_saving_c_files_triggers_: Saving C# files triggers a background build after a short debounce. Sibling .cs files compile together using Roslyn. Running instances keep their current assembly; Stop and Play applies the new build. Cached assemblies are reused when sources, compiler, runtime and bindings match.
compiler_status_no_c_compilations_record: No C# compilations recorded. Play a scene containing an active C# script.
compiler_status_could_not_open_vs_code_c: Could not open VS Code. Check that the editor is installed and the source still exists.
compiler_status_runtime_shader_compilati: Runtime shader compilation uses Slang; SPIR-V reflection uses SPIRV-Reflect. Shader errors are reported in the Console.
runtime_console_logging_continues_while_: Logging continues while the display is paused. Resume shows the retained history.

preferences_compression_load_help: Applies to subsequent texture loads. Already loaded textures are not recompressed in place.

water_wave_units: Direction: degrees in local XZ. Amplitude/wavelength: local units. Speed: units/s. Phase: radians. Up to 64 waves.
audio_panel_choose_clip: Open an audio file to preview its full waveform.
audio_panel_curves_help: Distance is normalized from zero to Max distance; values range from zero to one.
editor_status_background_details_hint: Click to keep this list open and scroll.
editor_status_project_settings_hint: Project settings and editor camera. Scene and asset changes are saved separately.
layouts_empty_hint: Arrange the panels, then keep them with New Layout.
layouts_invalid_name: Enter a valid layout name without path separators or reserved filename characters.
layouts_name_exists: A layout with that name already exists.
post_process_film_grain_camera_help: Drop a camera entity from the hierarchy. Grain properties are stored on that camera and edited here.
inspector_source_radius_help: Path tracing only. Radius of the emitting sphere in world units; zero gives hard shadows.
inspector_angular_radius_help: Path tracing only. Half-angle of the light disk in degrees; zero gives hard shadows.
material_thin_walled_help: Path tracing: a thin sheet transmits without bending and uses both interfaces. Roughness is ignored for this model. Closed solids use their actual interior distance for absorption.
material_bssrdf_help: Photon-beam diffusion transports light between surface points. Use a closed mesh with consistent outward normals. Coefficients are in inverse millimeters; 0.001 scene units per millimeter means one scene unit is a meter. Raster diffusion controls below are independent.
material_conductor_help: Path tracing uses exact complex-IOR Fresnel and GGX reflection. Presets sample PBRT metal spectra at 610/550/460 nm; they are RGB approximations. Raster and thumbnails use their normal-incidence reflectance in the existing metal BRDF.
material_medium_help: Path tracing: a closed dielectric may contain a homogeneous scattering medium. Coefficients use inverse scene units. IOR 1 and transmission 1 make an invisible fog boundary. Thin sheets have no scattering interior.
volume_height_help: Density decreases above the entity height. Below it, density stays constant.
volume_grid_help: The material stores a trilinear 3D density grid, with x changing fastest and voxel values in [0,1].
volume_empty_grid: No density grid assigned; this material has zero density.
volume_preview_help: Assign this material to a cloud or fog entity to preview its volume in the Scene or Game view.
volume_wind_help: Wind advances during Play and Simulate.
volume_material_help: Drop a volume material here, or click to open its properties in the Material Editor.
volume_unique_help: Create an independent copy for this entity. Other entities keep the shared material.
platform_placeholder_help: Preview only. These options do not affect builds, packaging or deployment yet.

world_selector_hint: Choose a bundled demo to open in the editor.
world_selector_empty: No bundled demo projects were found.
world_selector_select_hint: Select a world to see its details. Double-click a card to open it.
world_demo_Car_Demo_description: Drive a vehicle through a course with a follow camera and a HUD built with Canvas.
world_demo_Cloth_Playground_description: Simulate hanging flags, cloth draped over spheres, and deformable bodies. Use the hand tool to grab and move particles while simulating.
world_demo_Clustered_Lighting_descriptio: Explore Sponza and the open ground around it with 13,500 animated point lights and 1,500 animated spotlights.
world_demo_Instancing_description: Stress-test instanced drawing and culling with a 67 × 67 × 67 grid of cubes that share the same mesh.
world_demo_Optical_Materials_description: Compare refractive, transmissive, and metallic materials alongside absorption and subsurface scattering examples.
world_demo_Physics_Boxes_description: Watch one thousand dynamic boxes fall, collide, and settle on static geometry.
world_demo_Physics_Spheres_description: Watch one thousand dynamic spheres roll, collide, and settle on static geometry.
world_demo_Sandbox_description: Explore vehicles, character controllers, Canvas UI, and scene assets in one showcase.
world_demo_Skeletal_Animation_descriptio: See 400 Deadpool instances share one model while each runs its own animator.
world_demo_Sphere_Materials_description: Compare a five-by-five grid of sphere materials under the same lighting.
world_demo_Video_Gallery_description: Walk through five furnished homes, watch large TVs and a Forza street billboard, and meet scripted pedestrians around the outdoor cinema. 1080p raster.
world_demo_Terrain_Coast_description: Explore a 40 km² island with mountain ridges, dense forests, meadow clearings, coastal roads, clouds and shallow water.
world_demo_Skin_Subsurface_description: Compare the same head scan with standard lighting on the left and skin subsurface scattering on the right.
world_demo_Dragon_Transmission_descripti: Compare four glass dragons under a shared backlight. See how absorption and roughness change transmitted light.
world_demo_Mesh_Volumes_description: Explore five mesh-shaped volumes in a sunlit gallery. Compare density, scattering direction and coloured absorption with path tracing.
world_demo_Volumes_description: Compare sky-layer clouds, a local storm cloud, box mist, global haze, and a spherical fog volume backed by a density grid.
world_demo_Particle_Museum_description: Explore ten large particle installations using the complete Kenney particle and smoke packs. Discover fire, fountains, smoke vents, lightning, a magic gate, stardust, spell blades, impacts, and light sculptures. Press Play or Simulate.
world_demo_Animation_Playground_descript: Explore stairs and uneven ground with an orbit camera, idle/walk/run crossfades, foot IK, aim and reach exhibits, and imported characters.
renderer_clouds_help: Cloud entities supply bounds and wind; their volume material controls density and optics. Wind advances during Play or Simulate. Maximum eight active cloud volumes.
renderer_clouds_path_help: These quality controls affect raster clouds. Path tracing uses the volume transport solver.
world_demo_Clouds_description: Fly below, through and above moving voxel clouds. Compare sunlit cumulus, a dense local bank and cloud shadows with the raster renderer.
terrain_brush_tooltip: Terrain brush — select a landscape, then use Sculpt/Paint in the Landscape panel.
terrain_brush_help: LMB applies. Shift lowers/erases. RMB navigates. Escape exits. Flatten samples its target at the start of each stroke.
terrain_edit_budget: This source exceeds the 2049 x 2049 sculpt limit. Resample it before brush editing.
terrain_layers_help: Four normalized material weights blend albedo, normals and roughness. Automatic elevation/slope weights initialize the first paint stroke. Layer textures use triplanar projection; painted maps and sculpted heights save with the scene.
terrain_manage_help: Use Sculpt for height brushes and Paint for surface layers. The source heightmap stays unchanged.
particle_material_bloom_help: New particles capture these values at birth; current particles keep their appearance. Emission feeds the existing HDR bloom effect before tone mapping. Enable bloom in the scene renderer or a postprocess material.
terrain_edit_layers_pending: Separate sculpt edit layers are not implemented. Sculpt and Paint brushes are available through Mode.
terrain_grass_mesh_mix_help: Weights choose the model at each root. For example, 2:1 gives approximately two thirds / one third. Zero disables an entry. Up to eight meshes share the field density.
terrain_grass_mesh_help: Use a static Y-up mesh with UV.y from root to tip. Its base-colour texture and alpha cutout are retained. The selected mesh is reused for all three LODs; density thins with distance.
terrain_grass_mesh_invalid: Choose a static mesh with at most 8192 triangle indices. Skinned and larger meshes are not rendered as grass.
world_demo_GrassFlow_Meadow_description: A rolling meadow with tall, dense mixed grass meshes, travelling wind waves, an evening sun and the animated character controller.
terrain_grass_help: Growth follows the selected painted/automatic layer and sculpted terrain. Minimum elevation excludes water. Raster only; bounded GPU buffers limit density in dense fields.
wind_area_help: Directional areas cover the world. Box/sphere areas use the entity transform and blend at their boundaries. Rotate the entity to turn its wind. Overlapping velocities add. Cloth and procedural grass share this field; clouds retain their own advection settings.
world_demo_Forest_Island_description: A compact island with dense woodland, meadow clearings, mountain ridges, roads, a lake, ocean, wind and clouds. 1080p raster.
cloud_grid_help: Authored cloud voxels store profile, detail type and density scale independently. Import a Version 2 cloud grid, or bake a cloud shape.
